jobDetails.title: Software Engineer- London
jobDetails.description:
About The Role

FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking a Software Engineer to work for our client within the Finance sector. This is initially a short-term engagement through to 31 December. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute quickly with minimal onboarding and work effectively within an established development environment.

About You

Requirements:


  • Strong software engineering background with the ability to hit the ground running.
  • Commercial experience in at least two of the following technologies:
  • C#
  • Python
  • TypeScript
  • Experience developing, maintaining and supporting production applications.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute within an existing team structure.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
Desirable Skills
  • Experience across all three core technologies (C#, Python and TypeScript).
  • Full-stack development experience.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and modern software development practices.
  • Experience working on business-critical or enterprise-scale applications.
Ideal Candidate
  • Self-sufficient engineer requiring minimal ramp-up time.
  • Proven track record of delivering quality code in fast-paced environments.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams and adapting quickly to existing processes and codebases.
About Us

FDM is an award-winning global leader in tech and business talent solutions, backed by more than 35 years of industry experience. We have centres across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, and a global workforce of over 2500 employees. FDM has shown exponential growth throughout the years, firmly establishing itself as an award-winning employer, currently listed on the FTSE4Good Index and as a 2026 Financial Times UK ‘Best Employer’.


Diversity and Inclusion

FDM Group is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, provincial or local laws.

Why join us

  • Career coaching, mentoring and access to upskilling throughout your entire FDM career
  • Assignments with global companies and opportunities to work abroad
  • Opportunity to re-skill and up-skill into new areas, develop non-linear career paths and build a skillset within your field
  • Annual leave and work-place pension

similarJobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
similarJobs.description: Lead Software Engineer Location: London, E14 5RE / Canary Wharf – Hybrid Job Type: Full-Time Skills: Lead Software Engineer, Laravel, React, Python, AWS, AI/ML, n8n, Claude Code, Cursor, Docker, Startups, DevOps We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer with a path to CTO to join our founding team in Canary Wharf. You’ll lead technical direction across our platform, mentor a growing engineering team and build AI-powered products using Laravel, React, Python and AWS. Connectivity matters. We’re BroadbandUK. We help millions of people each year make better broadband decisions because fast, reliable internet improves everyday life. We’ve already launched the UK’s first address-level price comparison service, built a speed test used by over a million people, and partnered with organisations like Openreach, Currys and The Telegraph. But we’re just getting started. BroadbandUK is a high-growth, revenue-generating startup entering an exciting new phase. One of our next major challenges is improving how broadband information is represented when people move home. Connectivity is an increasingly important characteristic of a property, yet useful broadband information is often limited or notably absent from property listings. We’re working with the industry to help make broadband information a standard part of every property listing and define the data structures that will make this possible. To achieve this, we are transitioning into an AI-first company, using large language models and automated workflows to transform how we solve connectivity challenges. This is a rare opportunity to help build a company from the ground up and become a household name that touches the lives of millions. Be part of a close-knit, ambitious team where you’ll learn quickly and work on challenges that matter, and we hope you’ll enjoy the journey as much as we do. What you’ll do As Lead Software Engineer, you’ll play a crucial role in shaping the future of BroadbandUK. You’ll work directly with the CEO and co-founders to: Mentor a growing team of engineers, guiding graduates and interns as they level up their skills. Shape the architecture and technical direction of our products, balancing scalability with speed of delivery. Design and integrate AI models and algorithms that unlock insights from national connectivity data to tackle real-world challenges. Leverage unique datasets from Ofcom, Openreach, independent networks and ISPs to uncover problems that directly impact how the UK connects. Develop retrieval and agentic systems , combining LLMs with vector search and automation to push the boundaries of how AI can be applied to connectivity challenges. Our stack Backend: PHP (Laravel), Python (for AI/ML workflows) Frontend: React, Next.js (preferred), with flexibility for other modern frameworks Infrastructure: AWS (including Lambda, S3, DynamoDB), DigitalOcean Data: MySQL, Redis, NoSQL stores Dev tools: GitHub, CI/CD, Docker AI & Automation: LLM APIs, vector databases, agentic workflow tools, n8n, Claude Code, Cursor Who we’re looking for We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer with a path to CTO to join our founding team and help shape the future of connectivity in the UK. 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building, shipping and scaling real-world products. Strong leadership skills: guiding teams and setting technical direction. An ownership mindset: you thrive in startup environments and like solving real problems and learning fast. Proven impact: you’ve built and scaled products, led projects that made a difference, contributed to open-source, or delivered results that truly moved the needle. Practical AI experience: some experience building with LLMs, retrieval, agents or related technologies is strongly preferred. We know no one ticks every box, but proven experience in leading engineering teams and building and scaling real-world products is essential. Why you’ll love it here Impact from day one: your work goes live quickly and matters immediately. Big challenges, close-knit team: complex, national-scale connectivity challenges that stretch you and help you grow fast. Freedom to innovate: we are independent and privately funded, with focus over noise. Growth and mentorship: a genuine path to senior leadership, working closely with the founders. Let’s build the future of connectivity together. BroadbandUK is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Apply Now To apply for the Lead Software Engineer role based in London, please send your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you would be a good match for this role by using the apply button provided on the page.

similarJobs.title: Software Engineer
similarJobs.description: As a Software Engineer in London, you'll play a key role in developing and maintaining software solutions that support the organisation's goals. Working in the not-for-profit sector, you'll help streamline processes and ensure technology is used effectively to make a real difference. Client Details This role is with a not-for-profit organisation based in London. Description Design, develop and maintain software solutions to meet organisational needs. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement new features and resolve issues. Perform troubleshooting and debugging to improve system performance. Contribute to technical documentation to support ongoing development and maintenance. Provide technical support and guidance to internal teams. Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement software solutions accordingly. Stay updated with emerging technologies to suggest innovative solutions. Profile A successful Software Engineer should have: Proficiency in programming languages and software development tools. Experience in designing and implementing software systems. A solid understanding of software development methodologies and best practices. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment. Familiarity with working in the not-for-profit sector is a plus. Job Offer Comprehensive pension plan. Generous annual leave entitlement. Lifestyle benefits to support your well-being. If you're interested in this role, apply now. People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

similarJobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
similarJobs.description: Full Stack Software Engineer London (Hybrid: Tue-Thu in office, WFH Monday & Friday) | Permanent | Our client has built a comparison service for the UK wealth industry - it's live and working - and they're now expanding their tech stack considerably. They're hiring a mid-level developer to join the core build, working directly with the CTO. They're looking for someone with the fundamentals to build on their stack who is a fanatic user of AI coding tools. What you'll be doing You'll work directly with the CTO on the platform behind everything they do. Day to day, that means: Designing, building and shipping features end-to-end across the platform Expanding the stack: new services, new integrations, and LLM-powered features built into the product itself Using AI development tools as standard practice - and helping shape how the team gets the most from them Contributing to architecture decisions as the platform scales Writing clean, well-tested code and reviewing others' work with care Debugging, profiling and improving performance, reliability and security What we're looking for You'll need: The fundamentals to build on the client's tech stack - TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node, PostgreSQL and AWS Strong coding fundamentals - data structures, API design, testing, version control, and the judgement to know when to be rigorous and when to ship To be a fanatic user of AI coding tools: they're part of how you work every day, you follow the space closely, and you have opinions about what works Experience building with or integrating LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) - or personal projects that prove the interest is real The ability to thrive in a small team where you'll wear more than one hat Comfort being in the London office Tuesday to Thursday Nice to have: Experience in fintech, financial services or other regulated environments Familiarity with RAG pipelines, embeddings, prompt engineering or agentic frameworks Cloud platform experience (AWS/GCP/Azure), CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code Open-source contributions or a portfolio of side projects - especially AI-related Startup or scale-up experience What you'll get Direct mentorship from and daily collaboration with the CTO Real influence over technical direction - the platform is live, but the expansion is just beginning Budget for AI tools, hardware, and learning & development Hybrid working: Tuesday-Thursday in the London office, Monday and Friday from home 25 days holiday plus bank holidays Pension scheme Oscar Associates (UK) Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. To understand more about what we do with your data please review our privacy policy in the privacy section of the Oscar website.

similarJobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
similarJobs.description: Senior Software Engineer About Us Exam Papers Plus is one of the UK's best-known names in 11+ and high-stakes exam preparation, trusted by over 100,000 families. We have built a large bank of exam resources, mapped to subject, question type, skill and difficulty, and recently launched a learning platform that adapts to each child's learning profile and puts that material in front of children and parents in a guided way. About the Role As Senior Software Engineer you will be a hands-on, full-stack contributor on our core platform, working closely with our Lead Engineer and an external development team that uses AI tools to move quickly without sacrificing quality. Your focus is shipping features at pace while holding a high bar on quality through thorough testing and code review. You will be a strong voice in technical discussions and a reliable pair of hands the team can lean on, without carrying the management load. What you'll be responsible for: Building and shipping features across our learner and content platforms (React, Node.js, NestJS), taking work from spec through to production. Using AI tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate your work, while owning the validation so that code quality, security and performance meet our standards. Following and helping to uphold our engineering practices, contributing to code reviews and writing automated tests so we do not accumulate technical debt. Working alongside the Lead Engineer and other Engineers, pairing when useful, sharing what you know and helping less experienced colleagues get unstuck. Contributing to design and architecture discussions for new features, flagging trade-offs and suggesting pragmatic solutions. What you'll bring: Three or more years as a Full-stack Engineer, with at least some of that time at a senior level. Strong TypeScript across our stack – a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo, React 19 with TanStack Start, Router and Query, Tailwind CSS, Prisma and PostgreSQL (Supabase), Better-Auth and Stripe, deployed to Google Cloud Run via GitHub Actions with Terraform-managed infrastructure. Comfort with AI-assisted development and experience using tools like Cursor or Claude sensibly in a day-to-day workflow. A track record of shipping quality code fast, balancing velocity with standards. A pragmatic approach – sensible trade-offs between perfect and good enough, always asking what matters most for the user. Ownership – you see the work you pick up through without constant oversight. Clear communication – you explain technical decisions well, give and take feedback, and work well with product and design. Experience in edtech, learning platforms, student data or educational workflows would help. What success looks like: You are consistently delivering significant features each sprint to a high standard, without adding technical debt. Your code is well tested, your reviews are thoughtful, and you help catch bad patterns before they land. Within three months the Lead Engineer can hand you complex work with confidence, and you are a go-to person for other Engineers. You have contributed to a handful of technical decisions that made the codebase simpler or faster to work in. You are using AI tools effectively, reliably validating what they produce, and helping the team do the same. What's On Offer: 55,000 to 65,000 depending on experience. Permanent, full time, hybrid with two days a week in our Clerkenwell, London office. 28 days' holiday and 5% employer pension contribution. Eligibility for the group bonus scheme. You must be based in the UK with the right to work here.

similarJobs.title: C++/ Python Software Developer/ London / £ High
similarJobs.description: In this role, your primary focus will be on engineering – crafting robust, low-latency, and high-throughput systems that directly drive trading performance. The role demands an elite level of coding ability, especially in C , and a deep interest in how software architecture impacts real-world execution. If you’re passionate about clean code, optimization, and pushing the limits of what software can do in production, this is the environment for you. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy high-performance C code to power algorithmic trading systems. Optimize latency-critical components through low-level systems programming, performance tuning, and efficient data handling. Engage in continuous refactoring, testing, and code review to ensure engineering rigor and production stability. Work across the stack—from network interaction to execution pipelines—and contribute to system-wide performance gains. Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers and researchers to translate abstract trading ideas into production-grade code. Stay current with modern hardware, compiler behavior, and systems-level development techniques. Build and maintain tooling to support automated testing, monitoring, and deployment in a Linux-based environment. What We're Looking For Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or Mathematics (minimum BSc or equivalent) from a red brick University. Proven experience as a software engineer—whether through professional roles, open-source contributions, or independent projects. Expert-level programming in C (required), with an emphasis on performance, memory management, and concurrency. Proficiency in at least one scripting language (preferably Python) for tooling and prototyping. Strong understanding of system internals—compilers, memory models, CPU architecture, and how code translates into hardware behavior. Familiarity with Linux systems and modern development practices (e.g., CI/CD, TDD, code reviews). Interest in algorithm design, data structures, and writing code that is both elegant and efficient. Clear communicator who can explain technical ideas and collaborate constructively with peers. Why Join Be part of a deeply technical, tight-knit engineering culture that prioritizes precision, pragmatism, and performance. Work on greenfield projects that have direct and measurable impact on real-world trading outcomes. Competitive compensation and the chance to be immersed in a fast-paced environment that rewards technical depth and curiosity. Apply:- Please send a PDF CV to
